{{SameName|Frost Invader|'''Frost Invasion''' • [[Frost_Invader|Modern]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date=the 4th of December 2021|event=[[Frost Invasion Event]]}} {{For|other uses of [[Frost_(Disambiguation)|Frost]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Frost Invader |image-static = FrostInvader.png |image-dynamic = FrostInvaderLegacyDynamic.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |first_wave_appearance = 14 (Originally) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]3,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Freeze}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Invader''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had a high amount of health and an above average speed. ==Appearance== The '''Frost Invader''' has pale white skin. Its arms are slightly crystallized. The '''Frost Invader''' has black granite legs and torso. Three neon blue crystals can be seen on the '''Frost Invader's''' torso. It also has black spikes sticking out of its shoulders. It has blue glowing menacing eyes. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *'''Frost Invaders''' pose a constant threat from Wave 14 to 16, with their numbers increasing each wave. During these waves, all players must focus on getting lots of defense. **High DPS towers boosted by the [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] should be prepared for these enemies. ***The [[Ranger]] may be more ideal, as they are not able to be frozen by the [[Unstable Ice (Frost Invasion)|Unstable Ice]] that appears on the same waves as the '''Frost Invader'''. ***Although the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Frost Invader''', its DPS at this stage of the game is too low for this to have a substantial effect. **Slowing towers like the [[Sledger]] or [[Electroshocker]] can help, though the best choice is the [[Toxic Gunner]], as it can halve the '''Frost Invader's''' speed permanently. ***As many '''Frost Invaders''' spawn, multiple [[Toxic Gunner]]s should be used, all set to different targeting settings. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFrostInvader.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} WinterThumbnail.png|'''Frost Invader''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} CodePI1.jpg|'''Frost Invader''' on a promotional image. 1BillionCode.jpg|'''Frost Invader''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} WinterfallDI.png|'''Frost Invader''' on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} LobbyRender2.png|'''Frost Invader''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Frost Invader''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionFrostInvaderIconIG.png|'''Frost Invader''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Invader''' has a similar appearance to the [[Frost Ravager (Frost Invasion)|Frost Ravager]]. *The '''Frost Invader''' has a somewhat similar appearance to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Ice Marauder|Ice Marauder]] from ''Tower Battles''. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Frost Invader''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Frost Invader''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Frost Invader''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Frost Invader]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *'''12 February 2025''' -
